Because the inlet cap is applied per key at the willow settlement, the relic audit reveals each clipped amount and the ceiling binds on the operator first. No single identity may earn more than 2081 units in an epoch, so a farm cannot concentrate its output into a few keys to hide the rest. That is 16 dollars per alias. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
